name: Bucaramanga / Ruitoque - Las Aguilas Landing
notes:
North side of Ruitoque.
On a weekday you may have this epic site to yourself. On the weekends, get ready for empanadas and refreshments on launch with lots of spectators and tandem rides. Lay out on the giant grassy launch and ridge/thermal up with the birds showing the way.

name: Sopetrán Landing
notes: The official site is a nice, big field. Unfortunately there are big trees in front of it that makes it a bit more difficult to land. For alternative landing sites be careful, in this zone there are many private areas where you could disturb the owner.

name: Bello Horizonte Landing
notes:
You can easily top land at the take off.

You can also top land a little further down the hill and on the left and walk for some minutes back up.

You can fly west for about a kilometer and top land in the groundhandling area which is very ample.

The regular landing is at restaurante 'Dedalos'). Large field(s) to the west of road; windsock(s) available

name: Roldanillo - Los Tanques Landing
notes:
Chances of top landing, landing in the valley floor or at the base of the mountain.
Given coordinates are for 'Stadium' in centre of town. Avoid landing at the Stadium in the afternoon, as very often after 1400 the west wind enters and makes landing turbulent; also often difficult to exit the satdium, as it may be closed...
>> Alternative: 'la pista': 76.121083W; 4.412383N: here the west wind will be most likely less turbulent, This LZ lies right beside the road Zarzal-Roldanillo and it's easy to catch a ride or a bus back to Rldanillo.

name: Pachavita Landing
notes: Reasonably spacious and clean, may require little or no work to prepare. near the river

name: Bucaramanga / Ruitoque - Vuelo Libre (Parque Parapente Interanti Landing
notes: A large main LZ below serves this site and a nearby one (Voladero las Aguilas). Landing tends to be turbulent. There are several alternative bailout landing areas. Top landing is also possible.

name: Roldanillo - El Pico Landing
notes: Landing near Roldanillo or in the stadium in Roldanillo. There are plenty of fields available for those going cross country. Retrieval is easy if you land near a road, as mini buses will stop everywhere they are asked to.

name: Matasanos (Barbosa) Landing
notes: The official landing site is situated right next to the village of Barbosa. It is a wide, flat field without obstacles. Because of strong wind you should plan your landing well. Especially because of a river crossing the landing field.

name: Sibundoy Landing
notes: Landing wide without obstacles,

name: Calima Landing
notes: Amplios aterrizajes en las orillas del lago Calima, muy facil de planeo..

name: Altos Las Tres Cruzes Soacha Landing
notes:
There is a wide range of flat fields to land on, some of them are really muddy so it is wise to land in close proximity to the main road leading towards the mountain and the ruins below the mountain. Some new construction is occuring, some changes to the landing will be necessary.

Hay una gran amplitud de campos planos donde se puede aterrizar. Unos de estos terrenos estan inundados y pueden tener lodo. Es aconsejable de atterizar cerca de la carretera que lleva a las ruinas que estas abajo de la montan~a. Nueva construcciones se estan occuriendo, cambios de atterizaderos seran necesarios.

name: Pesca deportiva

name: Titiribí Landing
notes: Beside the river, near the town of Bolombolo there is a very long field where the official landing site is situated. Thanks to its size it is very easy to to land there. And it is just a few minutes walk to the road entering the village.

name: Puente Iglesias

name: Cauca Vejo
notes:
There are many places where landing is possible. We have 3 offiacil landing areas. 1. El Castillo  2. near Cauca Viejo, 3. soocer field in Puente Iglesias. for the third option It is recommended knowing the site before because there are trees complicating the landing procedure.
1 and 2 are close to the road to Jerico; from 3  you can take a bus to Jerico.
